description: Requêtes servies rendues depuis le code (plans 04.1-18 et 04.1-23), paramètres publics ; tests/test_explain_statements.py vérifie chaque copie ; `python -m scripts.explain_statements regenerer` les réécrit.

requetes.sql:
SELECT cleabs, nature, usage_1, nombre_d_etages,
               hauteur, altitude_minimale_sol, altitude_maximale_toit
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (cleabs)
                   cleabs, nature, usage_1, nombre_d_etages,
                   hauteur, altitude_minimale_sol, altitude_maximale_toit,
                   ST_Distance(
                       geometrie::geography,
                       ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography
                   ) AS dist
            FROM batiments
            WHERE ST_DWithin(
                geometrie::geography,
                ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography,
                :rayon_m
            )
            ORDER BY cleabs, dist
        ) sub
        ORDER BY dist
        LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

WITH parcelle AS (
        SELECT p.geometrie
        FROM parcelles AS p
        WHERE p.id_parcelle = :id_parcelle
          AND p.code_departement = :department
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM parcelle) AS parcelles,
           count(b.cleabs) AS total,
           count(b.cleabs) FILTER (
               WHERE b.usage_1 IS DISTINCT FROM 'Annexe'
           ) AS hors_annexe
    FROM parcelle AS p
    JOIN batiments AS b
      ON b.code_departement = :department
     AND ST_Intersects(b.geometrie, p.geometrie)
     AND ST_Covers(p.geometrie, ST_PointOnSurface(b.geometrie))

SELECT id_parcelle, commune, prefixe, section, numero,
               contenance,
               ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometrie)) AS centroide_lat,
               ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometrie)) AS centroide_lon,
               ST_AsGeoJSON(geometrie) AS geometrie_geojson
        FROM parcelles
        WHERE ST_Intersects(
            geometrie,
            ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)
        )
        ORDER BY id_parcelle

SELECT id_parcelle, commune, prefixe, section, numero,
               contenance,
               ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometrie)) AS centroide_lat,
               ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometrie)) AS centroide_lon,
               ST_AsGeoJSON(geometrie) AS geometrie_geojson,
               ST_Distance(
                   geometrie::geography,
                   ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography
               ) AS distance_m
        FROM parcelles
        WHERE ST_DWithin(
            geometrie,
            ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326),
            :rayon_m / (111320.0 * GREATEST(COS(RADIANS(:lat)), 0.01))
        )
        AND ST_Distance(
            geometrie::geography,
            ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography
        ) <= :rayon_m
        ORDER BY distance_m, id_parcelle

SELECT id_parcelle, commune, prefixe, section, numero,

SELECT mg.id_mutation, mg.date_mutation, mg.nature_mutation,
               mg.valeur_fonciere,
               CASE mg.classe_mutation
        WHEN 'residentiel_maison' THEN 'Maison'
        WHEN 'residentiel_appartement' THEN 'Appartement'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS type_local,
               mg.surface_bati_totale AS surface_reelle_bati,
               mg.nombre_pieces_totales AS nombre_pieces_principales,
               mg.surface_terrain_totale AS surface_terrain,
               CASE
        WHEN mg.classe_mutation NOT IN (
            'residentiel_maison', 'residentiel_appartement'
        ) THEN NULL
        WHEN NOT (mg.est_vente OR mg.hors_stats_vefa) THEN NULL
        WHEN NOT mg.mono_local
             OR mg.surface_bati_totale IS NULL OR mg.surface_bati_totale <= 0
             OR mg.valeur_fonciere IS NULL OR mg.valeur_fonciere <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(mg.valeur_fonciere / mg.surface_bati_totale)
    END AS prix_m2,
               mg.adresse_numero, mg.adresse_nom_voie, mg.code_postal,
               mg.nom_commune,
               CASE mg.classe_mutation
        WHEN 'residentiel_maison' THEN '1'
        WHEN 'residentiel_appartement' THEN '2'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS code_type_local,
               NULL::text AS code_nature_culture,
               NULL::text AS nature_culture,
               NULL::text AS code_nature_culture_speciale,
               NULL::text AS nature_culture_speciale,
               ST_X(mg.position) AS longitude,
               ST_Y(mg.position) AS latitude,
               mg.classe_mutation,
               CASE
        WHEN mg.classe_mutation = 'mixte' THEN 'vente_mixte'
        WHEN mg.classe_mutation = 'commerciale' THEN 'mutation_commerciale'
        WHEN mg.classe_mutation = 'terrain_seul' THEN 'terrain_seul'
        WHEN mg.classe_mutation NOT IN (
            'residentiel_maison', 'residentiel_appartement'
        ) THEN 'mutation_multi_locaux'
        WHEN NOT (mg.est_vente OR mg.hors_stats_vefa) THEN 'nature_hors_vente'
        WHEN NOT mg.mono_local
             OR mg.surface_bati_totale IS NULL OR mg.surface_bati_totale <= 0
             OR mg.valeur_fonciere IS NULL OR mg.valeur_fonciere <= 0
            THEN 'surface_absente'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS prix_m2_raison,
               mg.mono_local AS mutation_mono_local,
               mg.nb_locaux_maison, mg.nb_locaux_appartement,
               mg.nb_locaux_commercial,
               CASE WHEN mg.mono_local THEN (
        SELECT m2.nombre_lots FROM mutations m2
        WHERE m2.id_mutation = mg.id_mutation
          AND m2.code_departement = mg.code_departement
          AND m2.code_type_local IN ('1', '2')
        LIMIT 1
    ) END AS nb_lots_source,
               mg.nb_parcelles, mg.hors_stats_vefa, mg.surface_bati_totale,
               parc.id_parcelle
        FROM mutations_grain mg
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT mp.id_parcelle FROM mutation_parcelles mp
        WHERE mp.id_mutation = mg.id_mutation
        ORDER BY mp.id_parcelle
        LIMIT 1
    ) parc ON true
        WHERE ST_DWithin(    mg.position::geography,    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography,    :rayon_m)
        ORDER BY mg.position::geography
            <-> ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography
        LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

SELECT c.id_mutation, bool_or(n.nombre = 1) AS isolee
    FROM mutation_parcelles c
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT count(DISTINCT o.id_mutation) AS nombre
        FROM mutation_parcelles o
        WHERE o.id_parcelle = c.id_parcelle
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM mutations_grain mg
              WHERE mg.id_mutation = o.id_mutation
                AND mg.code_departement = o.code_departement
                AND mg.position IS NOT NULL
          )
    ) AS n
    WHERE c.id_mutation = ANY(CAST(:ids AS text[]))
    GROUP BY c.id_mutation

          AND ST_DWithin(mg.position::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography, :rayon)

        mg.id_mutation, mg.date_mutation, mg.nature_mutation,
        mg.valeur_fonciere, mg.nb_locaux_maison, mg.nb_locaux_appartement,
        mg.nb_locaux_dependance, mg.nb_locaux_commercial,
        mg.surface_bati_totale, CASE
        WHEN mg.classe_mutation NOT IN (
            'residentiel_maison', 'residentiel_appartement'
        ) THEN NULL
        WHEN NOT (mg.est_vente OR mg.hors_stats_vefa) THEN NULL
        WHEN NOT mg.mono_local
             OR mg.surface_bati_totale IS NULL OR mg.surface_bati_totale <= 0
             OR mg.valeur_fonciere IS NULL OR mg.valeur_fonciere <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(mg.valeur_fonciere / mg.surface_bati_totale)
    END AS prix_m2, mg.hors_stats_vefa
,
                   ST_Distance(mg.position::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography) AS distance
            
        FROM mutations_grain mg
        WHERE mg.classe_mutation = :classe
          AND (mg.est_vente OR mg.hors_stats_vefa)
          AND mg.date_mutation >= :debut AND mg.date_mutation <= :fin
          AND mg.position IS NOT NULL

          AND ST_DWithin(mg.position::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography, :rayon)

            ORDER BY mg.id_mutation, mg.id
        )
        SELECT * FROM mutations
        ORDER BY distance ASC NULLS LAST, date_mutation DESC, id_mutation
        LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

WITH parc AS (
            SELECT geometrie FROM parcelles
            WHERE id_parcelle = :id_parcelle
              AND code_departement = CASE
                  WHEN LEFT(:id_parcelle, 2) = '97' THEN LEFT(:id_parcelle, 3)
                  ELSE LEFT(:id_parcelle, 2)
              END
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        candidats AS (
            SELECT d.numero_dpe,
            d.date_etablissement_dpe,
            d.date_fin_validite_dpe,
            d.numero_dpe_remplace,
            d.type_batiment,
            d.surface_habitable,
            d.etiquette_dpe,
            d.numero_etage_appartement,
            d.complement_adresse_logement,
            d.identifiant_ban,
            d.position,
            ST_Distance(
                parc.geometrie::geography, d.position::geography
            ) AS distance_m
            FROM diagnostics_dpe d
            JOIN parc ON ST_DWithin(
                parc.geometrie,
                d.position,
                :rayon_m / (111320.0 * GREATEST(COS(RADIANS(ST_Y(d.position))), 0.01))
            )
            WHERE d.type_batiment = 'appartement'
              -- A document kept without source geometry (DATA-02) is never
              -- attached spatially.
              AND d.position IS NOT NULL
            
        )
        SELECT c.numero_dpe,
            c.date_etablissement_dpe,
            c.date_fin_validite_dpe,
            c.numero_dpe_remplace,
            c.type_batiment,
            c.surface_habitable,
            c.etiquette_dpe,
            c.numero_etage_appartement,
            c.complement_adresse_logement,
            c.identifiant_ban
        FROM candidats c
        WHERE c.distance_m <= :rayon_m
          AND (
            c.distance_m = 0
            OR NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM parcelles p
                WHERE p.code_departement = CASE
                  WHEN LEFT(:id_parcelle, 2) = '97' THEN LEFT(:id_parcelle, 3)
                  ELSE LEFT(:id_parcelle, 2)
              END
                  AND p.id_parcelle <> :id_parcelle
                  AND ST_DWithin(
                      p.geometrie,
                      c.position,
                      (c.distance_m + :marge_m)
                      / (111320.0 * GREATEST(COS(RADIANS(ST_Y(c.position))), 0.01))
                  )
                  AND ST_Distance(p.geometrie::geography, c.position::geography)
                      < c.distance_m + :marge_m
            )
          )
        ORDER BY c.date_etablissement_dpe DESC
        LIMIT :limit

           word_similarity(search_text, unaccent(:query)) AS score
    FROM adresses
    WHERE search_text % unaccent(:query)
        
    ORDER BY score DESC , ABS(NULLIF(regexp_replace(numero, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::int - :target_numero) ASC NULLS LAST, (lower(btrim(coalesce(rep, ''))) = :target_rep) DESC, ban_id, id
    LIMIT :limit

SELECT g.code
    FROM geo_departements g
    WHERE ST_Intersects(g.geometry, ST_Transform(
            ST_TileEnvelope(CAST(:z AS integer), CAST(:x AS integer),
                            CAST(:y AS integer)), 4326))
    ORDER BY g.code

SELECT p.id_parcelle, p.code_departement, p.contenance,
           ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometrie, 6) AS geometrie,
           ST_X(e.point) AS lon, ST_Y(e.point) AS lat
    FROM parcelles p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ST_PointOnSurface(p.geometrie) AS point) e
    WHERE p.code_departement = ANY(CAST(:departements AS text[]))
      AND ST_Intersects(p.geometrie, ST_Transform(
            ST_TileEnvelope(CAST(:z AS integer), CAST(:x AS integer),
                            CAST(:y AS integer)), 4326))
    ORDER BY p.id_parcelle

SELECT mp.id_parcelle, COUNT(DISTINCT mg.id_mutation) AS nombre
    FROM mutation_parcelles mp
    JOIN mutations_grain mg ON mg.id_mutation = mp.id_mutation
    WHERE mp.id_parcelle = ANY(CAST(:ids AS text[]))
      AND mg.code_departement = ANY(CAST(:departements AS text[]))
      AND mg.code_departement = CASE
          WHEN LEFT(mp.id_parcelle, 2) = '97' THEN LEFT(mp.id_parcelle, 3)
          ELSE LEFT(mp.id_parcelle, 2)
      END
      AND mg.position IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mp.id_parcelle
SELECT min(date_mutation) AS debut FROM mutations_grain

SELECT g.code
    FROM geo_departements g
    WHERE ST_Intersects(
        g.geometry,
        ST_Expand(ST_Transform(
            ST_TileEnvelope(CAST(:z AS integer), CAST(:x AS integer),
                            CAST(:y AS integer)), 4326), CAST(:marge AS double precision)))
    ORDER BY g.code

SELECT ST_Intersects(p.geometrie, ST_MakeEnvelope(
            CAST(:ouest AS double precision), CAST(:sud AS double precision),
            CAST(:est AS double precision), CAST(:nord AS double precision), 4326)) AS dedans
    FROM parcelles p
    WHERE p.id_parcelle = :id_parcelle
      AND p.code_departement = :departement

SELECT mp.id_mutation, mp.id_parcelle
    FROM mutation_parcelles mp
    WHERE mp.id_mutation = ANY(CAST(:ids AS text[]))
    ORDER BY mp.id_mutation, mp.id_parcelle

SELECT p.id_parcelle, p.contenance, e.dedans,
           CASE WHEN e.dedans THEN ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometrie, 6) END
               AS geometrie,
           ST_X(s.point) AS lon, ST_Y(s.point) AS lat
    FROM parcelles p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ST_Intersects(p.geometrie, ST_MakeEnvelope(
            CAST(:ouest AS double precision), CAST(:sud AS double precision),
            CAST(:est AS double precision), CAST(:nord AS double precision), 4326)) AS dedans
    ) e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT CASE WHEN e.dedans THEN ST_PointOnSurface(p.geometrie) END AS point
    ) s
    WHERE p.code_departement = ANY(CAST(:departements AS text[]))
      AND p.id_parcelle = ANY(CAST(:ids AS text[]))
    ORDER BY p.id_parcelle
